author: Navya Dubey
title: Chennai to Face 5-Hour Power Cut Today: Check Affected Areas and Timings
text:
Updated 31 July 2025 at 08:45 IST
Chennai: Residents in several parts of Chennai will experience a scheduled power outage on Thursday, July 31, 2025, to allow for essential maintenance work. The power supply will be suspended from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM in various areas across Tambaram, Pallavaram, Adyar, Velachery, Vyasarpadi, and Avadi.
According to the announcement, the power cut is necessary to carry out routine maintenance work.
The affected areas are as follows:
Tambaram: ALS Nagar, Ramana Nagar, Adambakkam Main Road, North, East and West Mada Streets, Manickam Avenue, Padmavathy Nagar, Agaram Main Road, Vedachalam Nagar, SR Colony, IAF Road, Ricky Garden, Harini Apartment, Sumeru City, Ranga Nagar, Sarangasi Nagar, Tiruvannamalai Nagar, Kamaraj Highway, Pettai Street, Kannagi Street, Panchayat Board Road, and Chakra Avenue.
Pallavaram: Thiruvallam Periyar Nagar, Amman Nagar, Arulmalai Chavadi, Annai Anjugam, Sakthi Nagar, Pallavaram East, Thiruvallam, Venkatraman Nagar, Sivagami Nagar, Muthamizh Nagar, Gayathri Nagar, Krishna Nagar, Bhuvaneswari Nagar, Pasiyam Nagar, Manickam Nagar, and PBR Nagar.
Adyar: Besant Nagar, Rukmini Road, Beach Road, Arundel Beach Road, 7th Avenue, 30th Cross Road, MGR Road, Tiger Varadachari Road, Gandhi Nagar, Crescent Avenue Road, Crescent, Park 1st and 2nd Road, Gandhi Nagar 3rd Cross Street and 4th Main Road, Shastri Nagar Malviya Avenue, Subbu Street, MG Road, Marudeeswarar Nagar, LP Road, Canal Bank Road, KP Nagar 1st to 3rd Main Roads, KP Nagar 2nd and 3rd Cross Street, PV Nagar 1st and 2nd Street, Anna Avenue Area, Govindarajapuram, Sardarpattes Road, and Bhaktavatsalam 1st Street.
Velachery: Velachery Main Road, Matteo Street, Orandi Amman Kovil Street, Jagannathapuram, Rams and Seapros Apartments.
Vyasarpadi: Erukancherry Highway, PV Colony, Shastri Nagar, Indira Nagar Extension, Vyasarpadi Industrial Estate, Gandhi Nagar, Stephen Road, Vyasar Nagar, Gandhi Nagar, Pudunagar, MBM Street, Vyasarpadi Market, Central Cross Street, ABC Kalyanapuram, Satyammur-25th Street Garden, Pallath Street 1st to 3rd Street, Udaya Suryan Nagar, S.A. Colony and Sharma Nagar.
Avadi: Pattabiram, Sekkadu, Ayyappan Nagar, Sridevi Nagar, Thandurai, Kannapalayam, Gopalapuram, VGV Nagar and VGN Nagar.
Residents in these localities are advised to make necessary arrangements to manage without power during the specified hours. The power department regrets any inconvenience caused.
Published 31 July 2025 at 08:45 IST
